leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a React component hierarchy with three levels of nested components
Initialize and pass data through props from parent to deeply nested child components
Manipulate component structure to demonstrate props drilling patterns
Apply props drilling techniques to share state data across multiple component levels
Configure component props to maintain data flow through intermediate components
Implement a practical example showing both the utility and limitations of props drilling
Update component implementations to illustrate how props drilling affects code maintenance
